summary: Iter144 — Verified Post History (delete/clear/reuse buttons, white ConfirmDialog, cancel+confirm paths, toast, cross-tenant delete isolation), reuse_post_id 404, CSRF-protected delete, salon digest preview-safe scheduler + never-billed skip log + _digest_data staff aggregation, and GA4 page_view dedupe. Full public-booking / signup wizard flows were NOT driven end-to-end (multi-step selectors + LLM cost + tenant creation cleanup risk); GA wiring for trackBooking/trackSignup verified by code review + on-page dataLayer capture harness. 10/10 backend pytest pass (7 new + 3 pre-existing iter144).

critical_code_review_comments: routes/salon_digest.py send_salon_daily_digests: never-billed branch always upserts a skip log — good; but ignores `force` — a super-admin re-run with force=True won't retry these tenants. Consider: if force and no invoices → still skip but log 'forced_no_invoices' for observability.

routes/mira_studio.py _reuse_block relies on the past post's caption+topic verbatim; if the past caption included stale prices, Mira may regenerate with stale prices. Consider stripping numeric prices before feeding into reuse prompt or asking Mira to re-fetch current tariff.

SocialHistoryPanel.jsx confirmDelete: on 401/network error the local posts array is untouched (good) but toast text uses e.response?.data?.detail which for FastAPI 403 CSRF returns {'detail':'CSRF token missing'} — surfaces as a raw string; wrap into a friendlier message.
frontend/src/lib/analytics.js swallows ALL exceptions silently — fine for prod, but a dev-mode console.warn on failure would aid debugging when gtag is misconfigured.
App.js `_lastGaPath` is module-level (survives navigation) — correct for SPA dedupe; but on hard reload it's reset which is expected. No issue.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (Post History delete/clear/cancel, regression, page_view dedupe); booking + signup full-wizard flows not driven

context_for_next_testing_agent: New reusable pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_iter144_reuse_and_digest.py covers: (a) POST /mira-studio/social/generate with reuse_post_id='does-not-exist' → 404; (b) DELETE /social/history/{unknown} → 404 + CSRF-less → 403/401; (c) database.IS_PREVIEW_ENV True on preview; (d) routes.salon_digest._digest_data(MM_TID) returns revenue/bills/top_staff etc; (e) never-billed tenant (miracurl-whitefield ceeceec8-...) gets salon_digest_log skip entry via send_salon_daily_digests(force=False). Uses .env manual-parse (no dotenv) and rebinds database._raw_db + routes.salon_digest._raw_db to a fresh AsyncIOMotorClient inside asyncio.run() to avoid closed-event-loop errors with motor's lazy loop binding. Post History Playwright flow requires dismissing [data-testid=whats-new-modal] (Got it button) first — otherwise its backdrop intercepts pointer events and blocks card clicks. ConfirmDialog appears via Radix portal (role=alertdialog + data-testid=social-history-confirm) with white bg rgb(255,255,255).
rca_of_the_issue: No product bugs found. One Playwright-side gotcha documented: WhatsNewModal (z-[80], black/70 backdrop) intercepts clicks on Post History cards until explicitly dismissed. Tests must call a `dismiss_whats_new` helper after every navigation until localStorage flag persists. Also: motor + pytest cross-loop — mitigated by asyncio.run + rebinding _raw_db per test.
